items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I made some recordings with...let's see, with someone else too, that...a little clarinet player. I can't think of the outfit we were with, though. O'Brien, I think it was Jimmy O'Brien.

ctx.x: Those are some good records, alright.

And I don't think I ever heard any of them records. Never even heard of them. Well, they're great. Yeah. Well, you know, I...I...I...I went...I made some recordings with...let's see, with someone else too, that...a little clarinet player. I can't think of the outfit we were with, though. O'Brien, I think it was Jimmy O'Brien. Oh yeah, Jimmy O'Brien.
